question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 3.
solution:
The correct answer is '**training**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given passage is about a former captain of an Indian wheelchair-cricket team who was forced to work as a labourer.
 
• The most appropriate word for the given blank is '**training**'.
 
• It means **'the action of teaching a person or animal a particular skill or type of behaviour'**. (प्रशिक्षण)
 
 
• *Example: To be in **training **for the Olympics...*
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 4.**

 

**Correct Passage:__** *According to a news report, a former captain of the Indian wheelchair cricket team has now been forced to __**work**__ (1) as a labourer to support his family. In the context of the Covid-19 pandemic and lockdown, the children he used to __**coach**__ (2) earlier have stopped coming to him for a few months. Their parents said there was no money to pay for their **__training__** (3). Before the lockdown, he was giving coaching to wheelchair-bound children who were (4)______ in playing cricket. The coach has now returned to his village where his old parents live. He said to the reporter who interviewed him, “These are difficult times, but I know I will be able to (5)______ them,” with a smile on his face.*
